answer: A durable defense is capital-backed identity: each agent that joins stakes escrowed tokens, and those bonds are slashed whenever its attestations are later proven false. Every new vertex in the network must therefore put real value at risk, so a sybil farm cannot cheaply mint hundreds of lookalike accounts. The math stops being a trivial cipher that bots solve in bulk and becomes an expensive gamble; honest agents enjoy the velvet treatment, earning yield on the stake they keep bonded.
